easter_cherry.label: Cherry on top
easter_cherry.hint: Somewhere a machine still pays in fruit.
easter_cherry.reveal: Three cherries on a machine nobody maintains anymore.

konami_mode.label: Retro palette
konami_mode.hint: Up up down down… you know the rest.
konami_mode.reveal: The cabinet flips to a 1987 palette and the statue winks.

found_back_room.label: Back of house
found_back_room.hint: A wall that isn't quite a wall.
found_back_room.reveal: The STAFF ONLY corridor behind the north tiles.

easter_plant_whisper.label: The talking plant
easter_plant_whisper.hint: Stand still near the lobby greenery.
easter_plant_whisper.reveal: The lobby ficus whispers a horse's name. It is never right.

easter_statue_pat.label: Statue etiquette
easter_statue_pat.hint: Everyone touches the golden statue. Not everyone is polite.
easter_statue_pat.reveal: Pat the statue twice and it returns the favor.

easter_blake_lock.label: Lock of the week
easter_blake_lock.hint: Ask the bookie what he actually likes.
easter_blake_lock.reveal: Blake's lock of the week board — undefeated at being wrong.

egg_phantom_floor.label: The floor that isn't
egg_phantom_floor.hint: Elevators skip a number for a reason.
egg_phantom_floor.reveal: Press the missing floor button and the tower hums back.

egg_wrong_number.reveal: A wrong number that knows your name and your chip count.

egg_aquarium_tap.label: Do not tap the glass
egg_aquarium_tap.hint: The sign says do not. The sign is a suggestion.
egg_aquarium_tap.reveal: Tap the reef glass and the sand tiger taps back.

egg_jackpot_bell.label: The old bell
egg_jackpot_bell.reveal: A brass bell above the slot aisle nobody has rung since 1999.

egg_delano_ghost.label: Delano ghost floor
egg_delano_ghost.hint: The quiet tower keeps quieter guests.
egg_delano_ghost.reveal: A Delano corridor where the carpet pattern never repeats.

egg_green_room.label: Green room list
egg_green_room.hint: Backstage has a guest list. You are not on it.
egg_green_room.reveal: The House of Blues green room rider, entirely in green M&Ms.
